(2) According to petitioner, there is a
drain which is not being cleaned for the last
several years. By means of this writ
petition, petitioner has sought the following
relief:
"i) To, issue a writ, order or
direction, in the nature of mandamus
commanding Respondents to forthwith
construct a pucca covered drain/tunnel/culvert
for the proper and permanent disposal of
water of "Agni Ghadheranala" from the
eastern-southern side of the petitioner's house
bearing Khet No. 1843, Ward No. 2, Khadi
Bazar, Nagar Panchayat Bhikiyasain, District
Almora, within a stipulated time frame as fixed
by this Hon'ble Court, preferably within 3
months and further direct the respondent
authorities to immediately clean and remove
the accumulated garbage, sludge and stagnant
dirty water from the vicinity of the petitioner's
house and to ensure regular cleaning and
maintenance of the said area."
(3) Relief as claimed cannot be

granted in a writ petition. Writ petition is,
however, disposed of with liberty to
petitioner to make representation to the
concerned authority. If he makes
representation within ten days from today,
decision thereupon shall be taken, as per
law, within one year thereafter.
